name: Matron Aralla
source:
Matron Aralla has been running the orphanage for around nineteen years now. The kids sometimes find her scary, but she has a very kind heart. She doesn't talk much about what she did beforehand, but she's very talented at raising children, so it could be linked to that.

[From in-game profile]
